caption: The drawing depicts a four-wheeled cart with a curved frame and a seat, most likely a baby carriage or early stroller. The carriage is rendered in a realistic style with careful attention to detail and shading, using muted colors such as cream, brown, blue, and dark green. The structure features a curved, wooden or painted body with accent lines in yellow, red, and green, supporting two large spoked wheels at the rear and two smaller spoked wheels in front. The seat has a patterned blue cushion and a backrest that appears cushioned in a reddish-brown color. There is a folding canopy cover above the seat, drawn in a glossy, dark green or black material, with decorative green fringe hanging along the edge, supported by metal rods. Two long, metal handles extend from the rear of the carriage, likely for pushing or pulling. In the lower right corner, there is a line drawing providing the side and front elevations of the carriage with corresponding measurements labeled as 38" and 24". The composition is centered on a cream-colored background bordered with a thin red line, with the artist credited as ERNEST TOWERS JR.
title: Doll Coach
